plugins.name: DSP Enhancer (Bass & Stereo Width)
plugins.description: Lightweight AudioWorklet DSP effect plugin chained onto getAudioContext(): harmonic Bass Enhancer, Mid/Side Stereo Widener, and lossless instant Bypass.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Local Library Share (LAN)
plugins.description: Share selected local music folders over LAN with PIN/Bearer authentication, scannable QR code, embedded <mplay3r-app> web UI, HTTP 206 Range streaming, and a remote LAN client for Web & Desktop.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Live Broadcast & Listening Party
plugins.description: Stream live playback to synchronized listeners over LAN/SSE (with latency compensation, listener counter, session token & optional Icecast push) or P2P WebRTC directly from Web Audio.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Podcasts & Streaming Sources
plugins.description: Search and subscribe to RSS/Atom podcasts (iTunes & Podcast Index), resolve streaming platform links to open RSS feeds, resume playback per episode, control speed (0.75x-2x), skip -15s/+30s, download episodes offline, and connect open MediaSourceProvider addons.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Web & FM Radio
plugins.description: Stream web radios and FM/DAB+ IP broadcasts via Radio Browser, direct Icecast/SHOUTcast/HLS URLs, ICY live titles, favorites, and ISP box micro-plugins.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Freebox Radios (Multiposte)
plugins.description: ISP box micro-plugin adding Freebox multiposte radio channels (and French public FM IP fallback streams) to the mPlay3r Radio plugin.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Metadata Scraper (Cover Art & Synced Lyrics)
plugins.description: 100% opt-in metadata enrichment on track change: HD cover art (MusicBrainz + Cover Art Archive), synced .lrc lyrics (LRCLIB), persistent cache, polite rate limiting, and offline resilience.
plugins.author: jezoock

plugins.name: Audio Visualizers Pack
plugins.description: Lightweight audio-reactive visualizers powered by getAudioAnalyser(): Winamp spectrum analyzer with peak-hold, zero-crossing oscilloscope, WebGL GLSL shader, and fullscreen mode.
plugins.author: jezoock
